_comment: Per-model pricing, USD per MILLION tokens. Values below are Anthropic's standard published list prices (5m cache write = 1.25x input, 1h cache write = 2x input, cache read = 0.1x input). VERIFY against your own plan/contract and your exact model tier (e.g. Sonnet's >200K-context tier is priced higher) before trusting the cost figures. Keys are matched to a session's model ids first by EXACT id (e.g. 'claude-opus-4-8'), then by family normalisation ('claude-opus-4-8' -> 'claude-opus-4-x'). Unpriced models are warned about and left at $0.00 — never priced as another model. If your transcripts lack the 5m/1h cache split, cache_write tokens fall back to the cache_write_5m rate.
